reviewer: Independent review agent; no implementation authorship or prior approval

disposition.source_and_evidence: Suitable for an explicitly experimental draft PR with the documented limitations. No unresolved newly introduced source defect identified in this review.
disposition.operational_installation: HOLD: preregistered mining and repeated full-command latency criteria failed. Do not replace the operational command.
disposition.merge: Not approved by this review; draft review and operational acceptance are separate.

fresh_mining.baseline_comparison: Same mining observations on the frozen baseline; these are unmet absolute acceptance criteria, not an introduced regression.

repeated_full_command_latency.scope: API warm timing excludes startup; it cannot establish warm host-command acceptance. Cold-command thresholds passed in the evaluator receipt.

source_review.default_recall_preserved: Default keyword scoring and existing semantic/hybrid paths retain their behavior. Strict quote exclusion and correction-text overlap require explicit opt-in.
source_review.mining_scope: Added lexical clarification markers affect mining only. They do not create skill aliases or modify the deterministic gate.
source_review.offline_and_privacy: The adapter explicitly uses keyword retrieval, bounds corpus/input/output, strips source metadata, and treats previews as JSON data. Source review found no recalled-data execution, network call, telemetry, or corpus write in that path.
source_review.packaging: The standalone adapter is distributed through repository/sdist source and copied privately; it is not advertised as a wheel entry point. Installed wheel evidence is reported separately.
source_review.documentation: RESULTS.md and the Codex recipe state failed installation acceptance, preserve the initial failed evaluation, distinguish API/command latency and staged delivery, and limit synthetic claims. The cited project-instruction mechanism matches the locally retained official documentation.
source_review.public_identity_path_scan: No known owner identity, home/volume path, or private rollout filename matched in the reviewed changed text. Raw private logs and corpus were not read by this reviewer.

resolved_local_findings.finding: Corrupting the saved prior snapshot made uninstall overwrite configuration with damaged bytes and report successful restoration.
resolved_local_findings.resolution: Validate both saved snapshots against receipt SHA256 values before status or mutation.
resolved_local_findings.independent_retest: Temporary-target corruption of either snapshot made status/install/enable/disable/uninstall refuse while preserving the current target bytes.

resolved_local_findings.finding: A non-exec shell layer returned signal failure when the configured command received SIGTERM despite the child eventually returning empty evidence.
resolved_local_findings.resolution: Use exec for the stable stdlib parent; retain explicit bounded fallback when the parent or wrapper is unavailable.
resolved_local_findings.independent_retest: Launcher copies returned empty JSON/status 0 for absent parent/wrapper and for SIGINT/SIGTERM after worker startup. Signal tests confirmed the worker was reaped. No shared native staging files were modified by these tests.

assurance_evidence.reviewer_checks: Exact source/document review, frozen-runtime comparison, canonical-gate diff, git diff --check, public path scan, and independent temporary-copy lifecycle reproductions.
assurance_evidence.native_tests_build_and_smoke: Inspected checks.json; native suite/lint, wheel/sdist, and installed CLI smoke are parent-run evidence, not reruns by this reviewer.
assurance_evidence.native_host: Inspected native-checks.json: staged fresh Codex delivery and missing-package continuation are separate from holdout quality. The parent reports prior staging bytes restored and real operational configuration unchanged.
assurance_evidence.hermes_gate: NOT_CONFIGURED, not PASS; repository adoption was not forced.
assurance_evidence.private_evidence_boundary: No operational install was authorized by this review. Private transcripts remain outside Git; selected synthetic labels were inspected only after their evaluation was complete.
